name: Prologue Scanner
description: Compares resolved libc and dynamic-linker function entries with their backing ELF bytes to identify runtime code redirection or modification.

evidenceUnits.title: Resolved function-entry integrity
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Resolved libc or linker function entry bytes and their backing ELF bytes
evidenceUnits.proposition: A resolved function entry is redirected outside its expected module or differs from backing bytes
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: dlsym, dladdr, in-memory bytes, and backing ELF comparison
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on symbol resolution, expected module availability, and readable backing ELF data
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: Dynamic linker APIs and process memory are observable within the potentially instrumented process
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Modification supports code-redirection evidence but does not attribute a framework or intent

evidenceUnits.title: Function-entry pattern
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Architecture-specific branch and trampoline-like entry-byte patterns
evidenceUnits.proposition: The resolved entry bytes match the recorded descriptive pattern
evidenceUnits.availability: Requires a supported architecture and readable function-entry bytes
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The pattern is derived from the same process-visible bytes as the integrity comparison
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Pattern telemetry is diagnostic-only and does not independently affect assessment
